name: dumbbell thruster
description: A front squat that flows into an overhead press. It is a hard whole-body move that raises your heart rate.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.
